svg.aria-label: Same sum, two loop orders: memory is read in 64-byte lines
svg.title: Same sum, two loop orders: memory is read in 64-byte lines
svg.text: Same sum, two loop orders: memory is read in 64-byte lines
row by row: for i … for j … a[i][j]
16 neighbouring ints share one line: 1 miss, 15 hits
column by column: for j … for i … a[i][j]
every step jumps N × 4 bytes: a new line each time
